All non-essential frequencies will be down until further notice.|The pilot and Avril Heert|audio=ISBShuttlePilot-Heert-HotZone-WEK.flac|}} A [[human]] '''pilot''' for the [[ISB Tactical|Tactical division]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Imperial Security Bureau]] flew the [[ISB TAC shuttle|tactical shuttle]] [[TAC 171]] during a [[Raid on the Axis safehouse|mission]] to capture [[Axis network]] member [[Kleya Marki]] in [[1 BBY]]. He dropped off a group of eight [[ISB tactical agent|tactical agents]] and bureau [[ISB Supervisor|Supervisor]] [[Avril Heert]] at [[Tomkip Towers]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]], the location of Marki's [[Axis network safehouse|safehouse]], and then put his [[Limb|feet]] up in the [[shuttle]]'s [[cockpit]] while he waited for their return. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebel]] [[KX-series security droid|droid]] [[K-2SO]] then entered the shuttle and smashed the [[pilot]]'s head into the [[Starship|vessel's]] [[Comlink|comms unit]], [[Death|killing]] him. ==Biography== ===Into the hot zone=== {{Quote|They'll pick you up out front.|Joydali, to Avril Heert|audio=Joydali-Pickup-WEK.flac|}} [[File:ISBShuttlePilot-Cockpit-WEK.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=An armored Supervisor Heert stands over the shuttle of a seated Imperial pilot wearing an open-faced white helmet and white armor in the cockpit of the tactical shuttle TAC 171.|The pilot transported Supervisor Heert and a group of tactical agents to Tomkip Towers.]] A [[human]] served as a [[pilot]] for the [[Imperial Security Bureau]]'s [[ISB Tactical|Tactical division]] during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. In [[1 BBY]], the bureau [[ISB Supervisor|Supervisor]] [[Avril Heert]] and his [[ISB Attendant|attendant]], [[Joydali]], contacted ISB Tactical to request support in [[Raid on the Axis safehouse|capturing]] the rebel [[Axis network]] member [[Kleya Marki]], whose location he had narrowed down to [[Tomkip Towers]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]]. The pilot then flew eight [[ISB tactical agent|tactical agents]] in the [[ISB TAC shuttle|tactical shuttle]] [[TAC 171]] to pick up Heert from Marki's place of work, the gallery [[Galactic Antiquities and Objects of Interest]], before heading to Tomkip Towers. En route, the pilot summoned Heert into the [[shuttle]]'s [[cockpit]] to inform him and the [[Commanding officer|lead]] tactical agent, [[Sergeant]] [[Gharial]], that they were approaching the target area. When the supervisor ordered him to shut down all communications around the hot zone, the pilot then relayed the request to the [[Imperial Security Bureau control center|control center]] of the [[Imperial Security Bureau Central Office]], which initiated a blackout on all non-essential frequencies. This was noticed by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebel]] [[KX-series security droid]] [[K-2SO]], who was part of an extraction team sent to collect Marki. ===Feet up, head down=== {{Dialogue|TAC 2C|This is TAC 2C over by the bridge. Did we request an enforcement droid?|Pilot|Sorry. Uh, repeat, please.|Benzi|Not that I'm aware.|attr=A tactical agent, the pilot, and Sergeant Benzi become aware of K-2SO's approach|audio=TAC-2C-Pilot-Benzi-WEK.flac|src=}} [[File:TAC171Parked-WEK.png|thumb|left|300px|alt=With its wings folded, TAC 171 sits on a walkway in front of Tomkip Towers on Coruscant.|The pilot landed TAC 171 beside Tomkip Towers to deliver the tactical agents.]] Upon reaching Tomkip Towers, the pilot set the [[Starship|shuttle]] down outside and Heert and the tactical [[agent]]s disembarked, splitting into [[Team-One]], who were led by Gharial and entered the apartments with the supervisor, and [[Team-Two]], which was led by Sergeant [[Benzi]] and remained outside the building near the shuttle. The pilot remained in the cockpit, removing his [[helmet]] and putting his feet up on the controls, while he waited for the agents to return. Concerned about his allies' safety while the comms were down, K-2SO then headed for the Imperial shuttle and was spotted by the Team-Two tactical agent [[TAC 2C]]. TAC 2C then checked in over [[Comlink|comms]], asking if they had requested [[droid]] support. Hearing this from the cockpit, the pilot was confused and asked for TAC 2C to repeat the question, but Benzi cut in and denied that they had made any request. K-2SO then [[Death|killed]] TAC 2C and carried on to the shuttle, where the pilot was questioning Benzi over comms about backup. [[File:ISBShuttlePilot-Dead-JKE.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=The corpse of tactical shuttle TAC 171 lies on the shuttle's smashed dashboard, his blood splattered across the damaged displays.|K-2SO killed the pilot of shuttle TAC 171, breaking the vessel's comm unit in the process.]] K-2SO then eliminated{{InsiderCite|236|A Certain Point of View}} another member of Team-Two on the shuttle's [[Entry ramp|ramp]], alerting the pilot to his presence. The pilot scrambled for a [[blaster pistol]]{{Andor|Jedha, Kyber, Erso}} and demanded the droid stay back but K-2SO slammed the pilot's head into the shuttle's [[comm unit]], killing him and severing the remaining tactical agents' connection to the control center. The droid and his allies then killed all of the tactical agents and successfully extracted Marki. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Stand back! No—|The pilot tries to stop K-2SO|audio=ISBShuttlePilot-Death-WEK.flac|}} The pilot was confused by K-2SO's approach, not acting until it was too late. He had light skin, [[Color|blue]] [[eye]]s, and brown [[hair]] that included a mustache. ==Equipment== {{Quote|Are we calling for backup?''"
"''Nah, must be a local patrol. Send him back.|The pilot and Benzi speak over comms|audio=ISBShuttlePilot-Backup-WEK.flac|}} While flying TAC 171, the pilot wore a black [[Clothing|shirt]], black pants, black [[boot]]s, and black [[glove]]s with a white helmet, white [[Armor|greaves]], white vambraces, and a white chest plate that had a comms unit mounted on the right [[breast]]. He used a blaster pistol. ==Behind the scenes== The pilot was portrayed by [[David Stoller]] in the live-action [[Disney+]] series [[Star Wars: Andor|''Andor'']], first appearing in "[[Who Else Knows?]]," the eleventh episode of the show's [[Andor Season 2|second season]], which aired on [[May 14]], [[2025]].{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}} ==Appearances== *{{Andor|Who Else Knows?}} {{1st}} *{{Andor|Jedha, Kyber, Erso}} {{Corpse}} ==Sources== *{{InsiderCite|236|A Certain Point of View}} {{Imo}} ==Notes and references== {{Mediacat|soundcat=Audio files of unidentified TAC 171 pilot|imagecat=Images of unidentified TAC 171 pilot}} {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=TAC 171-ის უცნობი პილოტი }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:ISB tactical agents]] [[Category:Pilots]]
